verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a real-time analytics dashboard that tracks costs across all models and providers in one place. Per-key spend caps and service accounts whose spend is 'not tied to any user' suggest spend is attributed to keys and users, but no doc explicitly shows per-dimension spend breakdowns. Missing for 10: explicit per-key/per-user spend breakdown views, any team-level spend attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: Requesty's analytics dashboard gives you complete visibility into your AI usage across all models and providers. Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
